notes: Power Signatures: the meter is now remembered after the first connect (no more picking the port each time), with two opt-in tick boxes - 'Auto-connect to this meter' (reconnects on launch and the moment you plug it in) and 'Jump to this view when it connects' (auto-switches to Board Repair > Power Signatures on plug-in). Plus a 'Forget meter' button, and it now cleanly shows 'Meter disconnected' when you unplug it.
